---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- read_rds("data/mallards.rds")
mallards <- mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, month_num, sort = FALSE)
```
```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_speed = median(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_speed = min(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_speed = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_speed = sd(speed, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges()
```
